links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot versus specialist responses
links.effect: Retina specialists and Gemini produced more readable responses; ChatGPT 4.0, ConsensusGPT, and Claude 3 gave more detailed, accurate answers but required a higher reading level.
links.quote: In contrast, ChatGPT 4.0, ConsensusGPT, and Claude 3 delivered more detailed and accurate answers but required a higher reading level.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing readability, accuracy, and comprehensiveness of four LLM chatbots against human retina specialists for answering real patient questions in Portuguese, without testing specific deployment practices or guardrails.
